---
title: "React quickstart"
description: "Build a React capture screen and complete your first document scan."
icon: "react"
---

Add country and document selection, a live camera preview, automatic capture, and a completion screen to your React application. This example uses TypeScript and Vite.

<Info>
  You’ll need the SDK archive supplied by Bouncr, an API credential, a venue ID, and a registered capture-page origin. Serve your app over HTTPS, or use localhost during development.
</Info>

<Steps>
  <Step title="Connect your backend">
    Follow [Connect your backend](/external/backend) to include capture initialization data in your existing onboarding response or server-rendered page props.

    Pass the returned `token` and `configuration` to your capture screen. Your backend keeps the organization API credential and retrieves verification results.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Install the SDK">
    In your React app, install the supplied archive. Replace the filename with the one you received.

    <CodeGroup>

    ```bash npm
    npm install ./bouncr-capture.tgz
    ```

    ```bash bun
    bun add ./bouncr-capture.tgz
    ```

    ```bash pnpm
    pnpm add ./bouncr-capture.tgz
    ```

    </CodeGroup>

    Copy the browser assets into your public directory:

    ```bash
    node --input-type=module -e "import { cpSync } from 'node:fs'; cpSync('node_modules/@bouncr/capture/dist', 'public/bouncr', { recursive: true });"
    ```

    Your app should serve `/bouncr/index.js` and the accompanying assets. Copy this directory again whenever you upgrade the SDK.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Add the capture component">
    Create these files in `src/`. The component keeps the camera closed until the customer selects a country and document and presses **Open camera**.

    <CodeGroup>

    ```tsx Capture.tsx
    import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
    import type { CaptureState } from '@bouncr/capture';
    import './capture.css';
    
    type SDK = typeof import('@bouncr/capture');
    type CaptureInstance = Awaited<ReturnType<SDK['createCapture']>>;
    
    export type CaptureProps = {
      token: string;
      configuration: string;
    };
    
    export default function Capture({ token, configuration }: CaptureProps) {
      const video = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
      const capture = useRef<CaptureInstance | null>(null);
      const [sdk, setSdk] = useState<SDK>();
      const [state, setState] = useState<CaptureState>();
      const [documentType, setDocumentType] = useState('');
      const [completedId, setCompletedId] = useState('');
      const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState('');
      const [pending, setPending] = useState(true);
    
      useEffect(() => {
        setState(undefined);
        setDocumentType('');
        setCompletedId('');
        setLoadError('');
        setPending(true);
        let disposed = false;
        let instance: CaptureInstance | undefined;
    
        async function initialize() {
          // Keep the SDK module beside its worker and WASM assets.
          const url = '/bouncr/index.js';
          const module: SDK = await import(/* @vite-ignore */ url);
          if (disposed || !video.current) return;
          instance = await module.createCapture({
            video: video.current,
            token,
            configuration,
            onState(next) {
              if (disposed) return;
              setState(next);
              setPending(false);
            },
            onComplete(scanId) {
              if (!disposed) setCompletedId(scanId);
            },
          });
          if (disposed) return instance.destroy();
          capture.current = instance;
          setSdk(module);
          instance.start();
        }
    
        initialize().catch(() => {
          if (!disposed) setLoadError('The scanner could not load. Refresh to try again.');
        });
        return () => {
          disposed = true;
          instance?.destroy();
          capture.current = null;
        };
      }, [token, configuration]);
    
      const selecting = !!sdk && state?.phase === sdk.Phase.SELECTING_DOCUMENT;
      const capturing = !!sdk && state?.phase === sdk.Phase.CAPTURING;
      const choices = sdk && state ? state.allowedDocumentTypes
        .filter(type => sdk.supportedDocumentTypes.includes(type))
        .filter(type => type !== sdk.DocumentType.ENHANCED_DRIVERS_LICENSE
          || !state.allowedDocumentTypes.includes(sdk.DocumentType.DRIVERS_LICENSE)) : [];
      const countryNames = new Intl.DisplayNames(['en'], { type: 'region' });
    
      return (
        <main className="capture-page">
          <h1>Capture your document</h1>
          <p role="status" aria-live="polite">
            {loadError || (completedId ? 'You’re all set.' : sdk && state ? instruction(sdk, state) : 'Loading scanner…')}
          </p>
          {selecting && (
            <section aria-label="Document selection">
              <label htmlFor="country">Issuing country</label>
              <select id="country" value={state?.country ?? ''} disabled={pending} onChange={event => {
                setDocumentType('');
                if (!event.target.value) return;
                setPending(true);
                capture.current?.start(state?.scanId, undefined, event.target.value);
              }}>
                <option value="" disabled>Choose a country</option>
                {state?.countryCodes.map(code => <option key={code} value={code}>{countryNames.of(code)}</option>)}
              </select>
              <label htmlFor="document">Document</label>
              <select id="document" value={documentType} disabled={pending || !state?.country} onChange={event => setDocumentType(event.target.value)}>
                <option value="">Choose a document</option>
                {choices.map(type => <option key={type} value={type}>{documentLabel(sdk!, type)}</option>)}
              </select>
              <button disabled={pending || !state?.country || !documentType} onClick={() => {
                setPending(true);
                capture.current?.start(state?.scanId, Number(documentType), state?.country);
              }}>Open camera</button>
            </section>
          )}
          <video ref={video} autoPlay playsInline muted hidden={!capturing} />
          {capturing && <button onClick={() => capture.current?.stop()}>Cancel capture</button>}
          {completedId && <p>Scan reference: <output>{completedId}</output></p>}
        </main>
      );
    }
    
    function documentLabel(sdk: SDK, type: number) {
      const D = sdk.DocumentType;
      return new Map([
        [D.DRIVERS_LICENSE, 'Driver’s license'], [D.ENHANCED_DRIVERS_LICENSE, 'Driver’s license'],
        [D.STATE_ID, 'State or provincial ID'], [D.PASSPORT_BOOK, 'Passport'],
        [D.PASSPORT_CARD, 'Passport card'], [D.PERMANENT_RESIDENT_CARD, 'Permanent resident card'],
        [D.VISA, 'Visa'], [D.OTHER_TRAVEL_DOCUMENT, 'Other travel document'],
      ]).get(type) ?? 'Document';
    }
    
    function instruction(sdk: SDK, state: CaptureState) {
      const { Phase: P, Guidance: G, DocumentType: D, ErrorCode: E } = sdk;
      if (state.phase === P.SELECTING_DOCUMENT) return 'Choose your document, then open the camera.';
      if (state.phase === P.SUBMITTING) return 'Uploading your document…';
      if (state.phase === P.PROCESSING) return 'Finishing up…';
      if (state.phase === P.SUPERSEDED) return 'Continue in the other capture window.';
      if (state.phase === P.STOPPED) return 'Capture canceled. Reload this page to start again.';
      if (state.phase === P.FAILED) {
        if (state.error?.code === E.COUNTRY_MISMATCH) return 'Choose the country that issued this document.';
        if (state.error?.code === E.DOCUMENT_TYPE_MISMATCH) return 'Choose the type of document you are scanning.';
        return 'Capture could not finish. Please try again.';
      }
      if (state.phase !== P.CAPTURING) return 'Preparing capture…';
      const side = state.requiredSides.find(side => !state.acceptedSides.includes(side));
      const prompt = state.documentType === D.PASSPORT_BOOK ? 'Show the passport photo page.'
        : [D.PASSPORT_CARD, D.PERMANENT_RESIDENT_CARD, D.VISA, D.OTHER_TRAVEL_DOCUMENT].includes(state.documentType) ? 'Show the page or side with the machine-readable text.'
        : side === sdk.Side.REAR ? 'Show the back of your ID.' : 'Show the front of your ID.';
      const guidance = new Map([
        [G.ALIGN_DOCUMENT, 'Place your document inside the camera view.'],
        [G.MOVE_CLOSER, 'Move closer while keeping the document in focus.'],
        [G.IMPROVE_FOCUS, 'Hold your document steady.'],
        [G.REDUCE_GLARE, 'Tilt your document slightly to reduce glare.'],
        [G.HOLD_STILL, 'Hold still. Capturing automatically…'],
        [G.FLIP_DOCUMENT, 'Turn your document over.'],
        [G.CLEAR_BACKGROUND, 'Place your document on a plain background.'],
      ]).get(state.guidance) ?? '';
      return `${prompt} ${guidance}`;
    }
    ```

    ```css capture.css
    .capture-page { max-width: 480px; margin: 32px auto; padding: 0 20px; font: 16px/1.5 system-ui; }
    .capture-page select, .capture-page button { display: block; width: 100%; margin: 8px 0 16px; padding: 12px; font: inherit; }
    .capture-page video { width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; }
    .capture-page [hidden] { display: none !important; }
    .capture-page output { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
    ```

    ```tsx App.tsx
    import Capture from './Capture';
    import type { CaptureProps } from './Capture';
    
    export default function App({ capture }: { capture: CaptureProps }) {
      return <Capture {...capture} />;
    }
    ```

    </CodeGroup>

    Supply `App` with the `capture` object from your authenticated onboarding response or page loader. The effect creates the SDK after the video element mounts. Cleanup releases the camera and scanner, including when initialization finishes after the component has unmounted. Capture state drives React’s controls and instructions. When fresh token/configuration props arrive, the effect releases the previous instance and initializes the replacement.

    <Accordion title="Using a different React framework?">
      Mount capture in a client-rendered route and keep initialization inside the effect. Serve the copied SDK assets at `/bouncr/`. Configure your bundler to leave the hosted module import intact; the example’s `@vite-ignore` comment does this for Vite.
    </Accordion>
  </Step>
  <Step title="Make your first scan">
    Run your application and open the route rendering `Capture`. Choose the country shown on your document, select its type, and press **Open camera**. Grant camera access and hold the requested side in view.

    The SDK captures automatically when the document is readable. Follow the instruction to turn it over if a second side is required. A completed scan displays **You’re all set** and its scan reference.

    <Tip>
      Keep React Strict Mode enabled during development. The component handles effect cleanup and a late initialization result.
    </Tip>
  </Step>
  <Step title="Retrieve the result">
    Use the completed scan ID from your backend with a credential scoped to `scans:results:read`:

    ```bash
    curl "$BOUNCR_API_URL/v1/scans/$SCAN_ID/result" \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $BOUNCR_API_TOKEN"
    ```

    Use the server result to decide the next step in your application. Replace the example’s completion message with your own review or onboarding screen.
  </Step>
</Steps>
